desc:
Project Playtime Multiplayer is a game that requires teamwork.

There are 2 role-based game modes:
🤠Player: Play as part of a team.
👹Monster: Your goal is to eliminate the other players.

There is currently 1 game mode:
🎁 First Mode: Collect 28 boxes and escape on the train.

🤠If you enjoyed the classic game, we’ve brought it back—and improved it!
